title: Automatic Construction of a Korean Toxic Instruction Dataset for Ethical Tuning of Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on constructing a 'Korean Toxic Instruction Dataset for Ethical Tuning of Large Language Models'. It aims to 'improve the ethical robustness of LLMs' by creating a dataset of 'unethical instruction-output pairs' and evaluates model responses based on categories like 'ethical' and 'unethical'. Ethical considerations are central to the paper's purpose and its 'Ethical Statement' section.
